Experimental design for psm_tmt_phospho and psm_tmt_phospho_total

Source: R/psm_tmt_phospho.R
tmt_phospho_design.Rd

A data.frame giving the Condition (Control/Treated), Timepoint (T1/T2) and Replicate for each sample in psm_tmt_phospho and psm_tmt_phospho_total, with rownames matching the quantification column names.

Usage

tmt_phospho_design

Format

An object of class data.frame with 16 rows and 4 columns.
